*   **Flattened Warped Output ($O_f$):** A space-to-depth transformation $S_s$ maps every $4 \times 4$ block of the high-resolution warped image to a single low-resolution pixel.

**Upscaling:** Two upscaling blocks are applied.
*   **Perceptual Loss:** $L_{X,P} = ||\phi(X_{test}) - \phi(X_{t}^{GT})||_2^2$. $\phi$ is a VGG-19 feature extractor.
**Generate Ground Truth AO (Training only):** For high-resolution ray-casting, spawn 512 secondary rays per surface point to simulate Ambient Occlusion.
**Compute Screen-Space Flow:** Calculate $F_{t}^{LR}$ as described above.
**Warp Previous Output:** Upscale $F_{t}^{LR}$ via bilinear interpolation to high resolution.
**Network Inference:** Input $I_{t}^{LR}$ (5 channels) and $O_f$ (96 channels) into SRNet.
**Post-Process Mask:** Clamp $M_{test}$ to $[-1, +1]$, then rescale to $[0, 1]$ to create $M_{t}^{0,est}$.
